Precinct returns as compiled by the MIT Election Data and Science Lab from the states' and counties' official results. Absentee, early, and provisional ballots that a county reported only countywide stay in their own countywide rows, so those votes are not spread among the precincts. Precincts take their shape from the state's or county's official precinct file where one matches the precinct's county and code or name; the others are placed within their county.
